objective: Define the smallest boundary that lets accepted ready-only handoff-contract metadata feed non-executing Verilator command metadata, estimate-command metadata, and operator-plan metadata, while keeping command execution, operator-plan execution, runtime handoff execution, RTL execution, compare execution, measurement, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, and upstream landing claims out of scope.

definition_decision.weakest_point: Command argv, estimate command, and operator plan are operator-facing names that can be over-read as executable Verilator support or measured performance evidence. This boundary therefore defines them only as non-executing metadata derived from an already accepted ready-only handoff contract, with estimate metadata separated from timing and all execution still deferred.
definition_decision.operator_goal: A later implementation may add an importable helper that consumes accepted handoff-contract fixture metadata and returns a structured operator-plan metadata object using existing sidecar authorities, without executing commands or expanding parser ownership.

future_operator_plan_metadata_shape.estimate_metadata_boundary: efficiency_estimate may be computed as planning metadata only; estimate_command is printed metadata only and must not be executed by this boundary

not_ready_for_sidecar_handoff_contract_m.expected_behavior: return or raise a structured not-ready result that preserves the closed handoff metadata reason and plan_resolution_readiness

unsupported_for_sidecar_handoff_contract.expected_behavior: return or raise a structured unsupported result that preserves the closed handoff metadata reason

malformed_or_prepopulated_handoff_contra.expected_behavior: raise before command synthesis, efficiency estimate, or operator-plan metadata construction

required_tests_for_next_review_or_implem: ready handoff-contract metadata may define command_argv, estimate_command, and operator_plan metadata only after accepted input preconditions pass
closed not-ready or unsupported handoff-contract metadata cannot produce operator-plan metadata
malformed or prepopulated handoff-contract metadata fails before command synthesis, efficiency estimate, or operator-plan metadata construction
efficiency_estimate is planning metadata only and does not become timing or speedup evidence
parser-preserved source_files and filelists remain preserved inputs and are not treated as source closure, dependency expansion, or allocation authority
command execution, operator-plan execution, runtime handoff execution, RTL execution, compare execution, timing, runtime/ABI changes, and automatic allocation remain absent

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_handoff_contract_operator_plan_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether this is the correct next boundary after accepting ready-only handoff-contract metadata
whether command argv, estimate command, and operator-plan metadata can be treated as non-executing planning output
whether efficiency_estimate metadata is safe to define without timing or speedup claims
whether closed, unsupported, malformed, or prepopulated inputs are blocked before command/operator-plan metadata construction
whether parser-preserved source files and filelists remain non-authoritative for source closure and allocation
must_not_claim: coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a new public CLI or workflow
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
